steps.label: pipe-select
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> SELECT a, b

steps.label: pipe-extend
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> EXTEND a+b AS total

steps.label: pipe-set
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> SET b=b+1

steps.label: pipe-drop
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> DROP b

steps.label: pipe-rename
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> RENAME b AS c

steps.label: pipe-as
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AS t |> SELECT t.a, t.b

steps.label: pipe-where
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> WHERE a=1

steps.label: pipe-aggregate
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP BY a

steps.label: pipe-join
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> JOIN (SELECT 1 AS a, 'match' AS tag) AS r USING (a)

steps.label: pipe-order-by
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> ORDER BY b DESC

steps.label: pipe-limit
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> LIMIT 2

steps.label: pipe-union
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS a, 40 AS b)

steps.label: pipe-intersect
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> INTERSECT DISTINCT (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b)

steps.label: pipe-except
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> EXCEPT DISTINCT (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b)

steps.label: pipe-tablesample
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (100 PERCENT)

steps.label: pipe-standard-ordinal
steps.sql: SELECT a AS k, SUM(b) AS total FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1,20 UNION ALL SELECT 2,30) GROUP BY 1

steps.label: pipe-group-alias
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP BY a AS k

steps.label: pipe-group-bare-alias
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP BY a k

steps.label: pipe-group-two-aliases
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n GROUP BY a AS k, b AS v

steps.label: pipe-group-ordinal
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP BY 1

steps.label: pipe-group-output-alias
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP BY total

steps.label: pipe-group-input-alias
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> EXTEND a+1 AS k |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP BY k

steps.label: pipe-group-and-order
steps.sql: FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 10 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1, 20 UNION ALL SELECT 2, 30) |> AGGREGATE SUM(b) AS total GROUP AND ORDER BY a DESC

steps.label: bucket-create
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE BucketDocs (Id INT64 NOT NULL, Body STRING(MAX), UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, HourBucket INT64 AS (UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(UpdatedAt,HOUR))) STORED, BodyTokens TOKENLIST AS (TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT(Body)) HIDDEN) PRIMARY KEY(Id)

steps.label: bucket-index-timestamp
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX BucketIndextimestamp ON BucketDocs(BodyTokens) ORDER BY UpdatedAt DESC

steps.label: bucket-index-hour
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX BucketIndexhour ON BucketDocs(BodyTokens) ORDER BY HourBucket DESC

steps.label: bucket-index-none
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX BucketIndexnone ON BucketDocs(BodyTokens)

steps.label: gql-propagation-full
steps.sql: GRAPH ProbeGraph RETURN 1 AS a FULL OUTER UNION ALL RETURN 2 AS b

steps.label: gql-propagation-left
steps.sql: GRAPH ProbeGraph RETURN 1 AS a LEFT OUTER UNION ALL RETURN 2 AS b

steps.label: gql-propagation-inner
steps.sql: GRAPH ProbeGraph RETURN 1 AS a INNER UNION ALL RETURN 2 AS a
